description: MCC Solutions' bookkeeping for small businesses (remote, clients anywhere in the U.S.): what is done each month, catch-up and cleanup, year-end packages, payroll and filings, how the work happens in QuickBooks Online, Xero or a spreadsheet, the published starting prices, and how to get started. Pass the business's size (transactions_per_month, and optionally accounts, months_behind, software, payroll) for a starting estimate built from the same prices as the site's form. Starting prices only, never a quote; not tax advice. For bookkeeping how-to questions, use ask and read_page on the guides.

employees.description: Employees on payroll, for a payroll processing estimate

months_behind.description: How many months the books are behind, 0 if current

needs.description: What they want; default is monthly bookkeeping, plus catch-up when months_behind is above 0

payroll.description: True if the business runs payroll that needs reconciling

transactions_per_month.description: Roughly how many bank and card transactions the business has in a month

name: bookkeeping_info
title: Bookkeeping: services, prices and a starting estimate
